```yaml
name: PoCL Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'
    
    - name: Install system dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y pocl-opencl-icd opencl-headers clinfo
    
    - name: Install Python dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pyopencl pytest
    
    - name: Run full test suite
      run: |
        PYOPENCL_COMPILER_OUTPUT=1 python3 run-all-tests.py -vv
      continue-on-error: true
    
    - name: Test summary
      uses: test-summary/action@v2
      if: always()
      with:
        paths: "test-results.xml"
        output: "test-summary.md"
        show: "failed,skipped"
        folded: "yes"
```
